method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited Act from the seat of the individual taxpayer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (tax years before 2024 answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No regulative rule: the only 'shall' in the deposited text ('shall determine the amount of income tax due ... in accordance with the table') is a computation, encoded as a function. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Ark. Code 26-51-201(a)(3) as set out by Acts 2024 (2nd Ex. Sess.), No. 1, s 1 (approved 19 June 2024), from the General Assembly's enrolled Act, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ar-acts-2024-2nd-ex-sess-act-1.txt, tables transcribed in ar-acts-2024-2nd-ex-sess-act-1.formulas.md. Net income is an input; the rest of Chapter 51 is not deposited.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the Act is an edict of government (Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, 2020); see SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run ar-income-tax-rates.l4 ; l4 run ar-income-tax-rates-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: In: Ark. Code 26-51-201(a)(3)(A), (B), (C). Out: tax years before 2024 (not covered); net income and everything else in Chapter 51 (residence, filing, deductions, personal tax credits, any indexing of the tables).
